ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Interpreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Transporting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Soil and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
